user.title: TPI for SAT
user.description: Select a Versatile Thermostat and set its valve control parameters.

data_description.thermostat: The Versatile Thermostat whose valves this algorithm drives. Select tpi_for_sat as its proportional function in VTherm.
data_description.c_int: Valve opening per kelvin of room error.
data_description.k_i: Rate at which the integral closes the valve above target.
data_description.tau_leak_h: Time constant with which the integral leaks back to fully open.
data_description.other_enabled: Close this valve in advance when another room is cold, as SAT then raises the flow temperature.
data_description.other_climates: Climates of the other rooms on the same boiler. Only those in heat mode with a target and current temperature count.
data_description.e_start: Largest error among the other climates at which this valve starts to close.
data_description.e_full: Largest error among the other climates at which this valve is closed at target. Must be greater than the start error.

error.invalid_thermostat: The selected thermostat is not in the entity registry.
error.invalid_e_range: The error to close fully must be greater than the error to start closing.
error.other_includes_thermostat: The other climates may not include the thermostat itself.

abort.already_configured: This thermostat already has a TPI for SAT configuration.
